events.label: Wallet finds the issuer’s authorization server
Wallet exchanges the one-time code for an access token
Wallet proves it holds its key and receives the credential
Verifier creates a request saying which credential it needs
Wallet downloads the verifier’s signed request
Wallet sends the presentation to the verifier
Verifier checks signatures, dates and holder binding
